# Load Packages & Colors 

```{r load-packages-colors}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, patchwork, iNEXT, phyloseq,
               install = FALSE)

# Load in colors for plotting 
source("code/colors_and_shapes.R")
```

# Load the Preprocessed Phyloseq Data

```{r load-data}
load("data/03_PreProcessing/preprocessed_phyloseq.RData")

# Take a look at the data 
preprocessed_physeq

# Intuition check on sequencing depth 
min(sample_sums(preprocessed_physeq))
```

# Calculate Biodiversity with Hill Numbers 

```{r calc-biodiv}
# Prepare input data 
## species = rows; samples = columns
iNEXT_input_df <- 
  preprocessed_physeq %>%
  otu_table() %>%
  data.frame()

# inspect
dim(iNEXT_input_df)
iNEXT_input_df[1:5, 1:3]

# Run iNEXT 
#iNEXT_data <- 
#  iNEXT(iNEXT_input_df, q = c(0, 1, 2), datatype = "abundance")

```
